items.text: Update 4 for MXGP 26 is now live on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S!

Steam will download it automatically. If it doesn't appear, restart Steam. This update brings a new Rut Impact setting, improved and increased terrain deformation in online races, and a long list of online and gameplay fixes shaped by your feedback.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/c99ca5e142bbb23a8e0b5cfbd525db43256876d5.jpg"]
⚠️ Racing online? Players on older builds and players on the latest build can't join the same lobbies, so make sure everyone in your group has updated.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/67c99a12b1ff932c7b5c7d2161806d3b719e8d8d.jpg"]
Online stability: overall improvements to the online experience, including several client-side and server-side fixes.
Terrain deformation: Terrain Deformation intensity improved and increased in online races.
Loading: fixed a random infinite loading when going to the next race.
End of race: fixed a case where a player was left in the race after the end timer reached 0 and did not move on to the next race.
Respawns: after a rider respawns, collisions with the rider and their bike are disabled for a short time.
Host leaving: a pop-up notification now appears when the host leaves a public session.
Private lobbies: the timer now starts when the host switches to Ready, as long as at least two players are in the lobby.
Private lobby settings: removed unnecessary reset buttons.
Paddock: fixed an issue where the bike setup screen could stay visible after the timer expired.
Spectator mode: added the remaining time and rider positions.
Ranking (MMR): recalibrated the ranking system, including division management.
PS5 paddock vibration: fixed a bug that could cause intense controller vibration in the paddock.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/f050dedd00800b1843be682384072b45a6cbd140.jpg"]
New: Rut Impact setting: adjust the impact of ruts in the settings menu. High is the default and keeps the rut intensity introduced in Update 3. Low brings back the intensity from before Update 3.
Getting back on track: fixed a bug that sometimes made it difficult to get back on track.
Stability: the bike is more stable when the rider is leaning heavily.
Suspension: improved suspension response in corners on rough terrain.
Gearbox: improved gearbox behaviour on the KTM 450cc and Husqvarna 450cc.
Camera: fixed an issue where the camera could stay stuck in rear or side view when the bike spawned on the track.
Time Practice: fixed AI riders sometimes spawning on the exit track.
Time Attack: "impossible" lap times are now ignored on upload and removed from save data.
Time Attack exit: fixed an issue that could cause an infinite transition when leaving Time Attack.
AI: improved AI performance at Foxhills.
Vibration and haptics: controller vibration and haptic feedback can now be turned off separately.
PC player names: names that exceed the maximum character limit are now truncated.
Replay: replay mode is smoother overall.
Let us know how the update feels in the comments, or report anything you find in #bug-report on our Discord: Join the Nacon Racing Discord
The Nacon Racing team and Artefacts Studio
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/60fb52d60600fdea731dc1897cae069800fba3c9.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/cf5ede51d2b0809e0f86dd8f46623f5f79b5b729.jpg"]
The 1st-person camera now points forward when you scrub and whip, instead of sideways.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/1d33971f71e064e7c20c219d5338a22dc99da11d.jpg"]
Every fix applies to PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S unless marked otherwise.
Online experience is generally smoother when seeing other riders
Tweaked the 1st person camera when doing scrubs and whip. Now the camera points forward instead of sideways
Fixed known crashes during Online games
Fixed crash linked to creating multiple profiles in workshop too quickly
Times that were made offline are now uploaded each time the game is started (if the console is connected to the internet before launching the game)
Fixed championship progression bug that reloaded the previous GP
Tweaked the ruts tracking
Fixed AI going off track in Arnhem
Fixed AI behavior in slopes in Foxhills
Fixed missing flyby at the start of Johannesburg and Foxhills
Fixed crash that could occur when going in Player Progression
Deactivated a driving aid (Speed Regulation Assist) that blocked the bike acceleration (PS5 & Xbox only)
Fixed sound issue from other bikes in replay and online (PC only)
The PC throttle fix from Monday 5 October is also live.
Nothing here is confirmed yet. Every change is tested first so it doesn't break anything else, and we'll share confirmed details closer to the November update.
Calmer suspension physics coming out of ruts, less bouncing
Removable handguards
Replay and spectator-mode animations
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/52b6e0509c495b5f204ddcd937079874c5733d8a.jpg"]

notes.title: 🎙️ Our MXoN Interview with Artefacts Studio

items.text: At the Motocross of Nations in Ernée, France, Alex VII sat down with Romain, Lead Producer at Artefacts Studio, to go through the patches and the November plans. In the same video, we try to recreate Lucas Coenen's win in the rain, check out the Fox gear from the Fox Holeshot Edition, and catch the bikes testing track-side.
As Romain put it: "Please keep giving us feedback."

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/d905eac1b4fadb8e8aa73718872f567b58c33a93.jpg"]
Bikes can accelerate again: players who had the bug where bikes weren't able to accelerate in The Compound, Grand Prix and Championship can ride again in those game modes.
We're carrying out a short maintenance on the online server tomorrow, Tuesday 6 October, at 9:00 CEST (8:00 BST · 3:00 EDT · 0:00 PDT). Online play will be unavailable for around 10 minutes.
Another update arrives for both PC and console this Friday, with various fixes. It also brings the PC and console builds in sync, as the PC version was previously behind.
Full patch notes are coming soon.

Thank you for jumping into MXGP 26 and for all the feedback so far. Our first PC update is now live on Steam.
Steam will download it automatically. If it doesn't appear, restart Steam.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46220904/f2fcc13e0c0b8154fd0a7866c9edd03aab7b1438.jpg"]
Custom keybinds: controls can now be fully remapped on PC
Online physics: improved bike physics for clients during online races
Physics polish: overall physics polishing across the game
Updated AI: general AI improvements on every track, in both MXGP and MX2
AI at Arnhem: fixed AI going off track
AI at Foxhills: fixed AI behaviour on slopes
First-person camera: further smoothing, so jitter and shake are reduced again. FOV still changes how noticeable it feels, so it's worth trying a few values
Online riders: the online experience is generally smoother when seeing other riders
Online joining: fixed issues when joining online sessions
Online crashes: fixed known crashes during online games
Player Progression: fixed a crash that could occur when going into Player Progression
Speed Regulation Assist: deactivated, as it could block the bike from accelerating
Johannesburg: fixed the Holeshot not triggering
Localisation: fixed issues in Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese
Track screenshots: updated across the game
Various fixes: a range of UI, gameplay and minor bug fixes
Let us know how the update feels in the comments, or report anything you find in #bug-report on our Discord: Join the MXGP 26 Discord
Thanks for riding with us. See you on the gate!
The Nacon Racing team and Artefacts Studio
